Code and data for more than 50 plots are available in this repository. Run `npm run list` to print an overview or take a look at the tables on this page.

## Individual Plots with Metadata

All plots are published on the [Open Research Data Platform](https://forschung.stadtgeschichtebasel.ch) of Stadt.Geschichte.Basel as `pdf` with metadata annotation. The numerical data behind the plots is also available as `csv`. The following section features tables with **selected** metadata on each `csv` file (in German)[^1]. The full `csv` metadata are available in this repository in `json` format.

[^1]: A few duplicated values are to be expected, because in several cases, multiple `csv` files make up one plot and thus share the same metadata for `title` or `description` etc.
